title: Chiune Sugihara Memorial Hall
axis: Positive X points from the lower west gallery to the timber main hall. Positive Z points from the parking approach past the front gable toward the rear.

nativeAxes.x: west extension toward main eastern gable

features.role: Building shell at the named public memorial and parking approach

identityStatus: The L-shaped OSM plan and parking edge fix the tall eastern rectangle and attached low western roofs. Both original Qualla photos show the main north door facing the parking approach with the low wing extending to its west.

terrainContact.basis: Unmodified elevation at the parking approach immediately outside the main timber porch.

notes: The town’s municipal facility plan records a two-story wood building of 293.7 square metres completed in 2000. The operator identifies Gifu hinoki timber. The exact Qualla photos fix the projecting gable and angled timber lattice, glazed upper gable and lower wood wing.
